items.instrument: heat-flux cylindrical Calvet-type calorimetric system Multi HTC 96 (Setaram, Caluire, France)
items.quote: Reaction temperatures were measured by DSC in a heat-flux cylindrical Calvet-type calorimetric system Multi HTC 96 (Setaram, Caluire, France). The equipment was calibrated using pure metals, Ag, Al, Au, In, Pb and Sn. Sapphire sealed in a duplicate tantalum capsule was used as reference material. Before measurement the analysis chamber was evacuated and then helium was applied as a flowing gas in the analysis chamber with a flow rate of 2 L/min. The DSC measurements were carried out with heating/cooling rates of 5 and 1 K/min and multiple heat cycling to ensure reproducibility.
